summary: This open‑source CLI indexes photos and video frames on macOS using AI and provides a desktop UI for quick retrieval. It is built in JavaScript, installs quickly (22.5 s) and requires no API key. It is aimed at macOS power users who need local media search, but its reliability is low (0 of 3 tests passed) and it has a very small community (28 stars). The main strength is the fast local install; the main caveat is the lack of proven functionality and limited differentiation from established tools.
